description.value:
Cast the preparation time of the more expensive Graft

Frequency once per day

Requirement Both Grafts have the same Vitae cost.

Prepare two Grafts for the Vitae cost of one.

When you prepare Grafts for the day, choose two you know of equal Vitae cost and pay that cost once for both. If you would prepare fewer than your normal daily maximum this way, this feat costs you nothing extra; it does not increase how many Grafts you may carry.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. A daily-prep cost-sharing rule has no rule-element hook; the closest confirmed-absent precedent is downtime time-halving shipping unencoded, extended here to cost-halving.
